t: Easyfix galvanised felt nails are essential fixings for securing roofing felt. Ideal for professional roofers and builders, these nails provide reliable attachment in both indoor and outdoor roofing projects. Each nail measures 3 x 13mm and features a galvanised finish, ensuring excellent corrosion resistance for long-lasting performance in various weather conditions.
b: Approx. 290 Nails Per Pack for Efficiency
